To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

international students are generally dissatisfied with the current regulations made for them by the government and the universities, and the main reason is that the regulations are not based on the needs of the students themselves.

the international student population in China has been increasing steadily in the past decade; however, there is still much room for improvement in the quality of education and services provided to international students; the international students are satisfied with the quality of education, but not with the quality of the services provided to them; the international students have a positive attitude toward the Chinese culture; and the international students have positive opinions about the future development of the education in China.

the level of satisfaction with current education of international students in Shanghai is low; the level of satisfaction is higher among those who have been in China for a long period than among those who have just arrived; the level of education satisfaction is higher among students from the United States and Canada than among students from other countries.

the need of international students in Shanghai,and the results of the study are of significance for the development of international education in China.
